purpose.zh: 练手撑平衡和肩部前倾力量
purpose.en: Build hand-balance and forward-lean shoulder strength.

text.zh: 肩前倾过手，锁臂背微拱，抬脚团身
text.en: Lean your shoulders past your hands, lock your arms, round your upper back and lift your feet

text.zh: 蹲姿双手撑地，手指略向外
text.en: Start in a crouch with your hands flat and fingers turned out.

text.zh: 膝盖收在胸口下方，保持平衡
text.en: Tuck your knees under your chest and hold the balance.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the feet without leaning forward.

cautions.zh: 手腕热身后再做；腕部或肩部疼痛时缩短时间或改简单版本
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first; if your wrists or shoulders hurt, shorten the hold or use an easier version.
